name: Corrientes
source: Instituto Nacional del Agua (INA) alert system a5 API; Prefectura Naval Argentina gauges
datum: m above the local gauge zero (cero de escala); INA lists the zero at 42.39 m IGN (Argentine national vertical datum)
license: INA alert system (alerta.ina.gob.ar); data from Prefectura Naval Argentina gauges. No license is stated on the API or site. Credit INA and Prefectura Naval Argentina; clear reuse terms before publishing.
notes: INA series 19 ('medición directa', variable 'Altura hidrométrica'), station Corrientes (INA station 19, PNA code 130), owner PNA.
INA publishes no per-value quality flag, so every value is marked measured. This includes the most recent days, which INA may still correct.
47973 raw observations. Days with more than one reading (averaged to a daily mean): 1793, from 2016-01-04 to 2026-07-01. Before that each day has a single reading.

Most common local timestamp by decade: {1900: '07:00', 1910: '07:00', 1920: '07:00', 1930: '07:00', 1940: '07:00', 1950: '07:00', 1960: '07:00', 1970: '07:00', 1980: '06:00', 1990: '06:00', 2000: '04:00', 2010: '04:00', 2020: '00:00'}. These are the times INA stored; the uniform 07:00 before 1980 looks like a loading convention, not a documented reading hour.
INA alert thresholds for this gauge: alert 6.5 m, evacuation 7 m, low water 1.83 m.

measurement_history.fact: INA/UTN report: the Prefectura series in INA's database starts 01 Jan 1901, with 72 missing days to June 2024.
The gauge zero is given differently across documents (41.95 m IGN, 42.01 m IGN, 42.39 m MOP; INA's database labels 42.39 as IGN). INA calls it uncertain.
An automatic level recorder was installed in 2013 and another automatic station on 21 Jan 2019. The INA series used here is the Prefectura staff gauge.
Not found: early reading hours and readings per day, gauge move dates, any early accuracy statement.

public_notes: This daily record from Argentina's Coast Guard gauge starts in 1901 and has very few missing days. The agency publishes no review flags, so recent values may still be corrected.
